label: Server URL
description: URL where the daemon can reach the server

label: API Key
description: Authentication key for daemon (generated via UI)

label: Network ID
description: UUID of the network to scan

label: Name
description: Name for this daemon

label: Daemon Mode
description: DaemonPoll: Daemon connects to server; works behind NAT/firewall without opening ports. ServerPoll: Server connects to daemon, for deployments where daemon cannot make outbound connections - requires providing Daemon URL

label: Daemon URL
description: Base URL where server can reach daemon

label: Port
description: Port the daemon listens on.

label: Docker Proxy
description: Optional local proxy for Docker API on the daemon host. Supports non-SSL and SSL; SSL requires additional config vars

label: Docker Proxy SSL Cert
description: Path to SSL certificate if using a docker proxy with SSL

label: Docker Proxy SSL Key
description: Path to SSL private key if using a docker proxy with SSL

label: Docker Proxy SSL Chain
description: Path to SSL chain if using a docker proxy with SSL

label: Interfaces
description: Restrict daemon to specific network interface(s). Comma-separated for multiple (e.g., eth0,eth1). Leave empty for all interfaces

label: Arp Retries
description: Number of ARP retry rounds for non-responding hosts (default: 2, meaning 3 total attempts)

label: Port Scan Packets per Second
description: Maximum port scan probes per second (default: 500, controls rate of TCP/UDP connection attempts to avoid overwhelming target hosts)

label: Port Scan Batch Size
description: Number of ports scanned concurrently per host. Higher values scan faster but may overwhelm some hosts

label: Arp Packets per Second
description: Maximum ARP packets per second (default: 50, go more conservative for networks with enterprise switches)

label: Use Npcap for ARP on Windows
description: Enable faster ARP scanning on Windows by using broadcast ARP via Npcap instead of native SendARP, which doesn't support broadcast. **Requires Npcap installation**. Ignored on Linux/macOS

label: Accept Invalid Scan Certificates
description: Accept invalid TLS certificates when scanning endpoints. Enabled by default since scanners probe arbitrary internal services.

label: Concurrent Scans
description: Maximum parallel host scans

label: Bind Address
description: IP address to bind daemon to

label: Allow Self-Signed Certificates
description: Allow self-signed certs for daemon -> server connections

label: Log Level
description: Logging verbosity

label: Heartbeat Interval
description: Seconds between heartbeat updates to the server
